name: The Magic Tanks (2 players)
author: Fatal_Justice
description:
An open sandbox action style driving game.

Controls:-
1) Move forward: 'W' (Player 1) and 'Up Arrow' (Player 2)
2) Move backward: 'S' (Player 1) and 'Down Arrow' (Player 2)
3) Move left: 'A' (Player 1) and 'Left Arrow' (Player 2)
4) Move right: 'D' (Player 1) and 'Right Arrow' (Player 2)
5) Toggle between First and Third person mode: 'F' (Player 1) and 'Right Ctrl' (Player 2)
